name: Heraclius II of Georgia
contribution: The king of the Kingdom of Kakheti from 1744 to 1762, and of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti from 1762 until his death in 1798.
image_credit: UnknownUnknown derivative work: Carnby · Public domain

checks.lead: Heraclius II (Georgian: ერეკლე II, romanized: erek'le II), also known as The Little Kakhetian (Georgian: პატარა კახი, romanized: p'at'ara k'akhi; 7 November 1720 – 11 January 1798), of the Bagrationi dynasty, was the king (mepe) of the Kingdom of Kakheti from 1744 to 1762, and of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti from 1762 until his death in 1798.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
